messages:
Samir Gupta: Quick cross-vendor sync — partners asking for a coordinated marketplace and SI handoff plan. We have mixed readiness across H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi, and B200. Propose a minimal-risk cadence.
Aisha Khan: Can we keep marketplace live for NA/EU as a soft-preview and gate APAC until vendor validation completes? That reduces customer impact.
Olivia Chen: Agree. Also need a clear fallback routing policy so streaming customers don't see surprises. Suggest: fallback order Gaudi -> Mi300 -> H200 -> H100 (configurable per tenant).
Marco Diaz: Perf note: Gaudi firmware 2.1.0 causes a sustained tail derate in long-lived sessions. Microcode hotfix targeted 2026-06-10; partner validation ~1 week. I'll add a perf delta table when available.
nvidia_anna: We'll drop microcode artifacts to partners 2026-06-10 and can provide embargoed perf numbers by 06-07. Integrator preview possible 06-12.
amd_suzanne: AMD update: MI300 driver 5.3.3 fixes an mmap regression; vendor ETA 2026-06-22. Partner validation expected 3 business days. We'll share an embargoed test plan on 06-18.
intel_bob: Intel/B200: firmware v4.1.7 reduces sustained-throttle frequency; shipping 2026-06-11. Early partner runs show improvement but extended stress needed.
Samir Gupta: SI dry-run proposal: NA/EU integrator window 2026-06-14--06-16, APAC integrator window 2026-06-28--06-30. Marketplace preview target NA/EU 2026-06-20. APAC listing gated until vendor validations (aim early July). OK?
Olivia Chen: Yes. Marketing wants copy that uses "preview" + a tooltip: "Limited capacity; region availability may vary. Fallback routing enabled." Add support Q&A and a runbook for OOM/derate incidents.
Marco Diaz: Test artifact I'll publish: `redwood/gaudi:preview-20260601` and `redwood/mi300:preview-20260610`. Smoke commands: ```bash
# gaudi smoke
docker run --rm --gpus=gaudi redwood/gaudi:preview-20260601 ./smoke.sh --concurrency 16 --duration 600
```
Samir Gupta: Legal check: any region gating needs review before public listing. @legal-bot please confirm required approvals.
legal-bot: Reminder: regional availability changes and marketplace copy require legal sign-off. Please attach approvals to the release pipeline.
release-bot: Pipeline note: `marketplace-preview` scheduled for 2026-06-20 17:00 UTC for NA/EU (pending artifacts & legal).
Aisha Khan: Action owners: Marco -> perf delta table + container artifacts, Olivia -> listing copy + support Q&A, Samir -> press cadence & integrator invites, Intel/NVIDIA/AMD -> embargoed validation matrices on vendor timelines.
Samir Gupta: Decision summary in-thread: partner integrator previews mid-June, NA/EU marketplace soft-preview 2026-06-20, APAC gated until vendor validation (vendor ETA windows above), fallback routing enabled by default, legal sign-off required before listing. I'll post calendar invites and a short confluence playbook. Thanks all :thumbsup:
